content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITION_OF_CONFIDENTIAL_INFORMATION
content_blocks.text: ‘CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION’ means any proprietary or confidential information disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party shall keep all CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION strictly confidential and not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._TERM
content_blocks.text: This agreement shall remain in effect until terminated by either party upon thirty (30) days written notice.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 12th day of October 2024.
